description: This file defines the initialization, destruction, and description generation for a UPnP WANDevice in a C-based implementation. It includes functions for creating device descriptions, cleaning up device instances, and initializing associated services and connection devices, specifically for IGD (Internet Gateway Device) functionality.

methods.description: Generates the XML description of a WANDevice given its UUID and file pointer.

methods.name: LOCAL INT32 _igd_wan_device_destroy(IN struct upnp_device * pdevice)
methods.description: Cleans up and releases resources associated with a WANDevice structure and its services.

methods.description: Initializes a WANDevice, its services, and connected devices, generating descriptive files and setting up event handlers.
